7.1.2.2 Frame reception in slave nodes
This section is only applicable to LIN slave nodes.
The LIN slave has no knowledge about the scheduling of the LIN master, it solely reacts
to received LIN headers reported by the LIN Driver with the header indication callback
function LinIf_HeaderIndication.
The requirements in this section are applicable to all frame types that are received
by the slave. An exception is the MRF for which only the header handling in Chapter
7.1.2.2.1 applies, but the response handling is described in Chapter 7.6.2 and Chapter
7.6.3.
